verdict_reason: Correct grouping that matches the spec's three role groups, but the inTheUnitedKingdom positional boolean mispredicts (BRANCH false while branch addresses are UK-only in the UI) and duplicates the receiving-UK rule.

todos.issue: RoleGroup.inTheUnitedKingdom() (lines 4-6, 8, 14) mispredicts: BRANCH(false) reads as 'branch addresses are not in the UK' although the frontend fixes a Branch address's country to United Kingdom, and SENDING(false) reads as 'origin/consignor are outside the UK' although the add form opens them on United Kingdom. The flag means 'the API requires the UK country', and it is passed as a positional boolean (SENDING(false), RECEIVING(true), BRANCH(false)). It also gives the UK rule a second home: ReceivingRolesInTheUnitedKingdom already names the receiving group in its name and message.
todos.fix: Must: no positional boolean on RoleGroup, and the 'receiving roles must be in the UK' rule has one owner whose name says it is a requirement, not a location. One way: drop the boolean field and constructor and have ReceivingRolesInTheUnitedKingdomValidator check group == RoleGroup.RECEIVING; or rename to requiresTheUnitedKingdom() if the flag must stay.
